turns.text: What are you trying to get out of this relationship with this other person?
turns.zh: 你想从和这个人的这段关系里得到什么？

turns.text: Are you seeking a wedding or do you want a relationship?
turns.zh: 你是想要一场婚礼，还是想要一段关系？

turns.text: Those are two very different things.
turns.zh: 这两件事可完全不一样。

turns.text: So in the chapter that's called “Partnering Well”, again I share my journey with my husband, the things that stuck out for me, what I was trying to find in another person, and how that worked out over the course of 30 years.
turns.zh: 所以在「好好做伴侣」这一章里，我再次分享了我跟丈夫一路走来的经历，那些对我来说特别突出的东西，我当初想在另一个人身上找到什么，以及这在30年里是怎么走过来的。

turns.text: We have… we are now celebrating our 30th anniversary with the hopes that, you know, it will create a conversation among the next generation of people trying to start to build their lives.
turns.zh: 我们……我们现在正在庆祝结婚30周年，希望这能引发下一代人的讨论——那些正打算开始构建自己生活的人。

turns.text: What do you look for in a partner?
turns.zh: 你在伴侣身上看重什么？

turns.text: What do you have to bring to a relationship yourself in order to make it whole and healthy?
turns.zh: 你自己又需要给一段关系带来什么，才能让它完整而健康？
